name: manual_6cd691
claim: OpenClaw 2026.10.6's own Google provider doc says it offers no new Gemini CLI OAuth or Antigravity OAuth setup: Google ended consumer Gemini CLI login on 2026-06-18 and the Antigravity terms prohibit third-party tools. The supported Google path is an AI Studio API key (or Vertex), with google/gemini-3.8-flash (alias gemini-flash) and thinkingLevel for effort; OpenAI Codex subscription OAuth is supported (openclaw models auth login --provider openai, add --device-code when the browser callback fails). The operator enters credentials and completes logins; the agent configures routing only.

decisions.notes: Read from the installed openclaw docs/providers/google.md and openai/setup.md on 2026-11-25.
